items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: I guess Presley would be the peak of it, I'd say, Johnny Ray and Presley and the Four This and the Four That

ctx.x: Yeah. Well, do you hold out any hope that perhaps with -- you might get some young people right out of college ...

Well, it has to run its course. See, these people are milking the situation dry; the validity of this whole pop movement we're in now, the point had been made in 1958, see, when the Beatles were popular, they were the last of that phase -- but I guess Presley would be the peak of it, I'd say, Johnny Ray and Presley and the Four This and the Four That -- you know, the groups in the early fifties.
But then since 1958 or so, the businessmen have just been milking every nickel that they can get out of the whole disco idea and everything like that.
